name: Untitled Die of Death Engine
desc:
What would it be like if Killers And Survivors from Die of Death Could Fight Each other, Mess around with Custom Emotes, and Maybe Mess around In-game? .. Or in better context, what would it be like if it was Dienation for ETERNITY?

Join the group for teasers, sneak peeks, news, bug/player reports, and more!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/35757005/Luna-s-Moons#!/about

All Credits along with Update-Logs are in-game, Its recommended to read the Warning Screen First Before Playing, This game was made for Fun and with Passion.

This game may have alot of bugs along your way, expect some to appear.

(This game Is NOT Meant to Copy Die of Death, or Untitled Forsaken Engine, This is just a recreation of the game with a few extra additions, Assets Such as Rigs [Badware, Harken, Etc], Audio, and Some Animations belong to Die of Death, All code was remade from scratch,.)
